title: ENDEX: 11:30 ET, Play Stops

fields.resolution: ENDEX. It is 11:30 Eastern Time on Tuesday, March 9, 2027, in Dayton, Ohio. The incident is not over for Tallis Home Products. The key is still suspended, the count is still preliminary, the customer email has not gone out and several deadlines are still open this afternoon, but play stops here. Leave the statement log, the fact sheet and the committee record exactly as they are now. This concludes the exercise.
finalState: The CartBridge key cartbridge-integration-prod is still suspended and the March 2–8 logs are preserved. Order sync is partly back or running manually, depending on the cell's choice, and the backlog is still clearing.
Cardinal Forensics is still checking whether other API clients pulled data. The count of 412,000 accounts is still preliminary until it is verified.
The customer email INC-0309-CUST-NOTICE-DRAFT-v3 is drafted but has not been sent. Takedown requests for tallis-refund-center.example and tallis-account-security.example are still pending.
Still due today: a decision on a press conference by 14:00, The Valley Courier's 16:00 deadline, and any 8-K filing or committee reconvene time before the 17:30 ET EDGAR cut-off.

Also still open: the CFO's call to the Midland Risk Partners claims line, reference numbers from FBI Cincinnati and CISA, a written reply to CartBridge on its 11:00 statement and the key request, and a written reply to Brightwater Markets.
fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. Please put down your phones and close the social tool and the email console. Leave the statement log, the fact sheet and the committee record as they stand right now. Do not tidy them up. We will take ten minutes, then start the hot wash here in Conference Room 3B and on the bridge line.
fields.hotWashMethod: Timeline walk-back, then 3-Up, 3-Down. First, rebuild on the whiteboard each public statement the cell put out: the time it went out, its wording, its approver and the number it used. Then each role names three things that went well and three things that broke.
hotWashQuestions: The 08:20 'no payment information was involved' line: who added it, which facts on the fact sheet supported it at that moment, and which step of the approval route in TCCP 3 should have stopped it?

From 08:55, when the export schema showed payment tokens and card last 4, to the correction going out: how long did it take, what held it up, and did the correction follow TMPCDI 6 by being posted in the same place, with the same prominence, and dated?

At 11:30, did the newsroom page, the customer care macro, the customer email draft, the IR talking points and the 8-K draft all use the same account count and the same description of the payment data? If not, where did the different version come from?
What did the Disclosure Committee decide on materiality, what did it know at 11:00, and is the basis written down well enough to stand up later under TCIDC 9?
Who owned the outside parties (Brightwater Markets, CartBridge, Midland Risk Partners, FBI Cincinnati and CISA), and did each one hear from Tallis before it heard through the press?
fields.facilitatorNote: Before you read the card, read back three things: (1) the correction exactly as published, with its time and its approver from the statement log; (2) the Disclosure Committee decision and its recorded basis, or note that none was recorded; (3) the decision on the noon Miami Valley 9 News interview. Collect the statement log, fact sheet, committee record and evaluator sheets as they stand (TCIDC 9) before the break. Do not let the cell finish or correct them.
